The '''MC95B''' was a class of [[Mon Calamari]] [[Star Cruiser]] that was active during the later stages of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]] the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. Many of these ships were part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]], a gargantuan [[fleet]] that consisted of 14,000 vessels that fought against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]].

==Description==
[[File:MC95_Star_Cruiser_variant.png|thumb|left|245px|An MC95B]]
The MC95B was a [[Star Cruiser]] was of [[Mon Calamari]] design.<ref name="Ships">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the First Order and the Resistance}}</ref> The MC95B characteristically was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] which gave it the capability of entering [[hyperspace]] at [[lightspeed]], and was equipped with at least eight [[sublight engine]]s. Two dual [[engine]]s were located on the port and starboard aft section, while there were four larger engine units at the rear in a square formation. The Star Cruiser<ref name="A Final Alliance" /> could be disabled when struck by powerful [[Force lightning]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> Characteristically of other Mon Calamari ship designs, the MC95B had a bulbous [[hull]] with differing modules, and uniquely had two angled diagonal canards at the bow of the ship, along with a large dorsal fin near the rear midship and a smaller fin in the ventral section towards the rear. The ship's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located on the forward command section near the bow of the vessel. It also contained a bridge tower at the rear of the vessel. The Star Cruiser was also equipped with [[laser cannon]]s and two [[hangar]]s on its hull on the port and starboard sides.<ref name="A Final Alliance" />

==Role==
As a [[capital ship]], the Star Cruiser had the ability to participate in [[Space warfare|naval warfare]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==History==
The MC95B Star Cruisers were in service by the time of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war between]]<ref name="Episode IX" /> the [[First Order]], a military junta that succeeded the fallen Old [[Galactic Empire]], and the [[Resistance]], a paramilitary force with roots to the dissolved [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and the defunct [[New Republic]].<ref name="BFA">''[[Before the Awakening]]''</ref> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Exegol Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Rebel Alliance and New Republic heroes [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] were dispatched on the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to rally the citizens of [[the galaxy]] in order to reinforce the Resistance, which had traveled to the ancient [[Sith]] redoubt [[Planet|world]] of [[Exegol]] in an attempt to defeat the resurgent [[Sith Eternal]], which had allied itself with the First Order, and save the [[galaxy]] from their rule.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:GalaxyFleet.png|thumb|right|250px|The 14,000 strong citizens' fleet contained many of the MC95Bs.]]
As the Resistance forces came close to defeat and suffered heavy losses, an enormous [[Citizens' Fleet]] of 14,000 vessels from across the galaxy arrived at Exegol and participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]], including numerous MC95Bs. Reinforced, the combined galactic force and the Resistance attacked the [[Final Order]], a massive fleet of planet-[[Death|killing]] [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] that numbered above 1,000 ships. As the two [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and [[Ben Solo]] fought the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] on the surface at the [[Sith Citadel]], [[Darth]] Sidious gained [[The Force|Force power]] from the [[Force dyad]] between Rey and Solo, and afterwards unleashed a torrent of powerful Force lightning at the galactic fleet, disabling all the vessels.<ref name="Episode IX" />

After Rey regained her strength and confronted Sidious once again, the lightning dissipated and the fleet regained its foothold. Darth Sidious was then eventually disintegrated by his own power after Rey deflected his lightning, finally killing him. The remaining [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] on Exegol were annihilated, and an [[uprising against the First Order]] took place throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Another MC95 Mon Cal variant.|Lucasfilm Art designer James Clyne on a social media post|<ref name="James Clyne MC95B">{{Instagram|username=clyne_design|url=p/CIGcHGtDQ_t|name=[[James Clyne]]|quote=Gobble gobble. Another MC95 Mon Cal variant.|archivedate=20201127181506}}</ref>}}
[[File:TRXCaseStudyv2-19.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The MC95B was one of the many new ship models created by ILM for ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker''.]]
The MC95B first appeared in the final installment of the [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]] and the [[sequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> The Star Cruiser was created when post-production needed more ships for the citizens' fleet by [[Lucasfilm]] art designer [[James Clyne]]. In his social media post, James Clyne clarifies that the ship is an MC95 Mon Cal variation. The [[MC95A Star Cruiser]], [[MC95C Star Cruiser]], [[MC95D Star Cruiser]],<ref name="James Clyne MC95B" /> and the [[MC95E Star Cruiser]]<ref name="Final Alliance MC95E">''[[A Final Alliance]]'' bonus feature of {{Film|IX}} Home Video set.</ref> were respectively titled "Mon Calamari Cruiser Variations A," "Mon Calamari Cruiser Variations C," "Mon Calamari Cruiser Variations D,"<ref name="James Clyne MC95B" /> "Mon Calamari Cruiser Variations E,"<ref name="Final Alliance MC95E" /> corresponding to their names. Identically, this Star Cruiser is titled "Mon Calamari Cruiser Variations B."<ref name="James Clyne MC95B" />
